summary: agent-orchestrator's README makes no quantitative claims and publishes no measure of agent task outcomes. Its one well-evidenced result is a frontend chat-responsiveness study with a committed Playwright harness, raw measurements.json and a documented command (e.g. first fetch 2,070.2 -> 151.6 ms), explicitly scoped to synthetic inputs and 3 runs; an AO-vs-Linear desktop comparison exists only as plan-doc tables whose scripts are not yet in the repo.
result_focus_note: manual classification of published_results: outcome = does the tool do its job; engineering = speed of the software itself
